resources.string: Android has not linked this watch to OpenWatch. Without the link, OpenWatch cannot record workouts that another app starts on the watch.
OpenWatch needs the Nearby devices permission to reach the watch.
The watch is not paired with this phone. Open Bluetooth settings and pair it; make the watch discoverable from its own Bluetooth settings first.

The OpenWatch app on the watch records your heart rate and what a sleep estimate needs, and keeps a week of it. Sync copies the new heart rate into Health Connect and writes one estimated sleep session per night.

resources.string: The watch keeps these settings itself. Read them to change them here.
The watch did not answer. Is it near and its OpenWatch app running?
Measures about every 10 minutes by day, to save battery. The day\'s curve gets coarse, and falling asleep without bedtime mode may go unnoticed. Sleep and workouts still measure often.

Lets the watch nap between heart rate readings while it records your sleep, instead of staying awake all night (about 4 percent of the battery an hour). Meant to use less; works only with heart rate from the sensor, not the Samsung platform.
Samsung sources need Developer Mode in the Samsung Health Platform on this watch; without it, the platform checks this app with Samsung. If a Samsung source fails, the watch uses its own sensor.
Heart rate from the Samsung platform
Allow it on the watch: open OpenWatch there and switch it on once.
Off: the watch\'s own sensor, read right away. On: the heart rate Samsung\'s platform measures, which arrives up to 10 minutes late while the screen is off. Workouts always use the sensor.
Off: heart rate variability at night from the raw pulse signal. On: from the platform\'s beat-to-beat data, which currently loses many beats, so fewer nights get a value.
Measures the skin temperature at your wrist while you sleep, once a minute. Uses little battery. The phone shows the change once three nights are recorded.
Measures blood oxygen at most once an hour while you sleep, with about 15 seconds of red light. Uses a little battery; skipped when your arm moves.
